name: Auntie Ool, Cursewretch
oracle_text:
Ward—Blight 2. (To blight 2, a player puts two -1/-1 counters on a creature they control.)
Whenever one or more -1/-1 counters are put on a creature, draw a card if you control that creature. If you don't control it, its controller loses 1 life.

needs.what: a `blight` cost key ("Blight N: the paying player puts N -1/-1 counters on a creature they control"), where the PAYER chooses one creature they control at payment time and the counters go on it through `add_counters` (so `counter_placed` fires); payable only if the payer controls a creature. It must work inside a ward cost (the `pay` spec of `ward_ability`'s `may`, paid by the targeting opponent) as well as on activated abilities and additional costs
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `put_counters` in `cost_keys` places counters on the cost's source permanent only (costs.py pays it to `source_oid`), so `{"put_counters": {"counter": "-1/-1", "amount": 2}}` as the ward cost would put the counters on Auntie Ool rather than on a creature the opponent chooses among their own; no other cost key (sacrifice, tap_permanents, remove_counters_from_among) puts counters on a chosen creature, and nothing in the engine or cards package knows the word blight
